label: Core
description: Code-backed platform primitives: triggers, agents, generic tools, control flow, outputs. Executed by apps/reasoner/reasoner/nodes.py, not the generic integration runtime.

nodes.label: Manual trigger
nodes.description: Start the workflow on demand; seeds the run input downstream.
nodes.search: start manual run on demand trigger begin

nodes.label: Webhook trigger
nodes.description: Start the workflow from an incoming HTTP request.
nodes.search: webhook http trigger incoming event start

nodes.label: Schedule trigger
nodes.description: Run on a schedule: hourly, daily 09:00, weekdays 09:00, weekly mon 09:00, or a 5-field cron (0 9 * * 1-5). Times are in the scheduler timezone (SCHEDULER_TZ).
nodes.search: schedule cron daily hourly weekly weekdays every monday recurring timer trigger

config.label: Schedule
config.help: hourly, daily HH:MM, weekdays HH:MM, weekly <day> HH:MM, or a 5-field cron like 0 9 * * 1-5. Saving the playbook makes this the schedule that runs.

nodes.label: AI agent
nodes.description: Reason over upstream outputs with a large language model. The workhorse for research, synthesis, extraction, transformation and summarization.
nodes.search: ai llm agent reason summarize synthesize extract classify write analyze transform parse

config.label: Model
config.help: Leave unset to use the deployment default (REASONER_MODEL). Set only when the user names a specific model.

config.label: Response format
config.help: json: the reply is parsed into outputs.<key>.data so branches and loops can use its fields (e.g. outputs.assess.data.verdict). Say in the prompt exactly which fields to return. A reply that isn't JSON fails the step.

config.label: Use brand context
config.help: Set true on every step that DRAFTS content for an audience (posts, emails, blog copy, battlecards, ad copy): the workspace's brand voice, product facts, positioning and claims to avoid are added to the system prompt. Leave false for analysis and classification.

nodes.label: Chat completion
nodes.description: Single-turn prompt → response, no tool use.
nodes.search: chat completion single turn prompt response llm

config.label: Model
config.help: Leave unset to use the deployment default (REASONER_MODEL). Set only when the user names a specific model.

nodes.label: Browser
nodes.description: Drive a real browser: navigate URLs and extract page text. For JS-heavy or auth-walled sites a plain HTTP request can't read.
nodes.search: browser navigate scrape extract page web visit javascript render click

nodes.label: Watch competitors
nodes.description: Snapshot every registered page (pricing, changelog, blog, careers) of the chosen competitors and report what changed since the last check. Each change is recorded as a signal. The usual first step of a competitor playbook.
nodes.search: competitor watch monitor track pricing changelog blog careers page changes diff market intelligence signal

config.label: Page kinds (blank = all)
config.help: Any of pricing, changelog, blog, careers, other.

config.label: Ignore lines matching (one regex per line)
config.help: Lines that change on every load but mean nothing (a visitor counter, a rotating quote). Timestamps, 'x minutes ago' and copyright years are already ignored.

nodes.label: Snapshot page
nodes.description: Fetch a web page (plain HTTP, honouring robots.txt, or a real browser for JavaScript pages), reduce it to its visible text, and store it when it differs from the last stored version.
nodes.search: snapshot page capture save web page version monitor scrape competitor

config.label: Ignore lines matching (one regex per line)
config.help: Lines that change on every load but mean nothing (a visitor counter, a rotating quote). Timestamps, 'x minutes ago' and copyright years are already ignored.

nodes.label: Diff against last snapshot
nodes.description: Compare a page snapshot with the version before it: lines added and removed. Records a page_change signal when this run found a new version.
nodes.search: diff compare changes previous snapshot what changed page version

config.label: Snapshot id
config.help: From an upstream Snapshot page node. Or leave blank and set URL to diff that page's latest snapshot.

nodes.label: Record signal
nodes.description: Record a market signal (news article, RSS item, Reddit or Hacker News post, review) so drafts can be traced back to it. Give one title, or a list of items with the path to each item's title and URL. Items already recorded are not recorded twice.
nodes.search: record signal save news article post review mention event traceability

nodes.label: HTTP request
nodes.description: Call any REST API or fetch any URL. The universal escape hatch for data sources without a dedicated node.
nodes.search: http api rest get post fetch request call url json rss feed

nodes.label: Run code
nodes.description: Execute a Python or JavaScript snippet in a sandboxed subprocess. Upstream outputs and run input arrive as JSON on stdin. Requires TOOL_CODE_ENABLED=1; otherwise the code is recorded, not executed.
nodes.search: code python javascript execute script transform parse compute csv json convert

config.label: Source
config.help: stdin = {"input": …, "outputs": …}; print a JSON object to emit fields

nodes.label: Database query
nodes.description: Run SQL against the operator-configured TOOL_DB_URL database. Without TOOL_DB_URL the query is recorded, not executed. Never touches the platform database.
nodes.search: database sql query select insert postgres rows

credentials.help: Postgres URL of the user-facing database this node may query

nodes.label: If / Else
nodes.description: Gate: evaluate a condition; when false, the entire downstream subgraph is skipped.
nodes.search: if else branch condition gate compare decide

nodes.label: Filter
nodes.description: Gate: pass the flow through only when the condition holds; otherwise skip downstream.
nodes.search: filter condition keep when rule gate

nodes.label: Human approval
nodes.description: Pause until a person approves, edits or rejects a draft in the Inbox (with a timeout). Required before anything is published. Approved: downstream nodes run and read the final text as outputs.<key>.content. Rejected or timed out: everything downstream is skipped.
nodes.search: approval approve review human in the loop sign off wait for person reject edit draft gate publish

config.label: Draft to approve
config.help: What the person reviews. They can edit it; the edited version is outputs.<this node>.content.

config.label: Approver
config.help: Who should decide. Shown in the Inbox and the notification.

config.label: Notify Slack (incoming webhook URL)
config.help: Defaults to APPROVAL_SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL. The Inbox works without any notification.

config.label: When it times out
config.help: skip: nothing downstream runs, the run finishes. fail: the run fails.

config.label: Signals (ids, optional)
config.help: Defaults to every signal recorded earlier in this run.

nodes.label: Wait
nodes.description: Pause the run on a durable timer, then continue: schedule an approved post for later. hours can come from upstream (e.g. {{item.delayHours}} inside a loop). from = run_start gives absolute slots (24 = a day after the run started) so items of a loop don't add their waits up.
nodes.search: wait delay pause schedule later timer sleep publish at time slot

nodes.label: Loop
nodes.description: Fan out: resolve a list and run the downstream branch once per item. Inside the body, {{item}} is the current element and {{loop.<key>.index}} the position; collected results appear as outputs.<key>.results.
nodes.search: loop foreach iterate items map fan out each repeat

nodes.label: Send email
nodes.description: Send an email over the platform SMTP server. Fails the node when SMTP is not configured or delivery fails.
nodes.search: email send mail deliver notify digest smtp

config.label: Body
config.help: Defaults to the most recent upstream text output

nodes.label: Send to Slack
nodes.description: Post a message to a Slack incoming webhook. Fails the node when the webhook URL is missing or Slack rejects the post.
nodes.search: slack post webhook message notify output

nodes.label: Generate report
nodes.description: Compose a markdown or PDF report artifact from upstream text.
nodes.search: report artifact markdown pdf compose document digest
